tax.heading: Provision for income taxes
tax.text:
Income before earnings in affiliated companies and income taxes for the three months ended September 30, 2026 increased by $73.1 million, year over year to $5.0 million.

Income tax expense for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $8.2 million. Income tax benefit for the three months ended September 30, 2025 was $0.5 million. Income tax expense is primarily determined based on the projected pre-tax income mix in countries with varying statutory tax rates and the impact of valuation allowances on tax losses.

net.text: Net loss was $3.1 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $67.1 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025 as discussed above.

net sales.heading: Net sales
net sales.text: Net sales for the three months ended September 30, 2026 increased by $21.9 million, or 5%, year over year to $472.8 million, primarily driven by favorable pass-through effect of higher year-over-year oil prices driven by Middle East conflict (13%), partially offset by unfavorable volume impact across all regions (-5%) and lower pricing under our annual contract agreements in the Rubber Carbon Black segment (-2%).

intro.text: Orion S.A. (“Orion”, “Company”, “we” or “our”), is a Luxembourg joint stock corporation ( société anonyme or S.A.), incorporated in 2014 as a Luxembourg limited liability company ( société à responsabilité limitée ). Our registered office is located at 6, Route de Trèves, L-2633 Senningerberg (Municipality of Niederanven), Grand Duchy of Luxembourg. Our principal executive office is located in Spring, Texas, U.S. We are one of the largest global producers of Specialty and Rubber Carbon Black. Carbon black is a powdered form of carbon that is used to create a variety of desired physical, electrical and optical qualities of various materials.

gp.heading: Gross profit
gp.text:
Gross profit decreased by $22.2 million or 4.9%, from $451.0 million in 2023 to $428.8 million in 2024.

The decrease was primarily driven by higher fixed costs, unfavorable impact from pass-through of raw material costs and lower cogeneration.

cor.heading: Cost of sales
cor.text: Cost of sales increased marginally by $5.8 million, or 0.4%, from $1,442.9 million in 2023 to $1,448.7 million in 2024, primarily to associated costs of higher Specialty Carbon Black segment volume and higher fixed costs.

ga.text: Selling, general and administrative expenses increased by $15.9 million, or 7.2%, from $221.9 million in 2023 to $237.8 million in 2024 driven primarily by higher freight and personnel costs.

net sales.text:
Volume increased marginally by 2.7 kmt, or 0.3%, to 934.8 kmt, year-over-year, primarily due to higher Specialty Carbon Black segment volume, partially offset by lower Rubber Carbon Black segment volume .

Net sales decreased marginally by $16.4 million, or 0.9%, from $1,893.9 million in 2023 to $1,877.5 million in 2024, driven primarily by pass-through effect of lower oil prices, lower Rubber Carbon Black segment volume and unfavorable foreign currency translation impact, partially offset by broad-based recovery in the Specialty Carbon Black segment across all regions.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Inventory
lines.why: Goods held for sale: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Equity-method investments
lines.why: Stakes in associated businesses, usually part of operations. Financial if held as an investment.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Wages, services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Short-term debt and commercial paper
lines.why: Borrowed money: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Finance lease liabilities
lines.why: Leases that work like a loan for the asset: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Pension and retiree benefits
lines.why: Promised to employees for their work: operating (some analysts treat the unfunded part as debt).

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
